🚨 JSP Development Corp. files for chapter 11 protection in Illinois

JSP DEVELOPMENT CORP.
📊 Assets: $1M-$10M | Liabilities: $1M-$10M | Creditors: 1-49 | Industry: Residential and Commercial Real Estate Development | District: Northern District of Illinois

Chapter 11 – Filing Summary
_____________________________________________
Northern District of Illinois • November 1, 2026

JSP Development Corp., a Naperville, IL-based residential and commercial real estate development firm, filed for chapter 11 protection on November 1, 2026 in the Northern District of Illinois.

As stated in court records and recent public notices, the company’s current operations are focused on managing a portfolio of Chicago-based real estate assets, including properties on South Harding Avenue, West Fillmore Street, and West Polk Street. The filing follows a judgment of foreclosure and was timed to stay a judicial sale of a commercial asset scheduled for November 2, 2026.

Key Details
_____________________________________________
– Foreclosure judgment issued against primary commercial asset in February 2026 [Source: Lawndale News (2026)]
– Judicial sale of 1430 S. Harding Ave scheduled for November 2026 [Source: Lawndale News (2026)]
– Residential portfolio includes multiple properties on West Fillmore and West Polk streets as of May 2026 [Source: Lawndale News (2026)]
– Principal Jae Young Noh identified as lead defendant in 2026 real estate litigation [Source: Cook County Circuit Court (2026)]

Residential and Commercial Real Estate Development: NAICS 236117 – New Housing For-Sale Builders. The company operates as a developer and owner of residential and commercial properties in the Chicago metropolitan area.

⚖️ Professionals
_____________________________________________
Debtor's Counsel: Gregory K. Stern, P.C.

#Bankruptcy #Chapter11 #RealEstate

*Data from court filings & verified sources. All sources should require independent verification. Not financial advice.
